description: This file defines a composable UI component for an overlay that prompts the user to enter a PIN to unlock the application. It uses Jetpack Compose to layout UI elements such as Text, Spacer, and a custom PinPad component, wrapped in a Box with styling.

methods.name: LockOverlayComposable
methods.description: A composable function that displays an overlay prompting the user to enter their PIN, with a callback for submission.
